originalTitle: How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
content:
AI drastically shortened its design time; it will only get faster

Matthew S. Smith is a contributing editor for IEEE Spectrum and the former lead reviews editor at Digital Trends.

OpenAI’s Jalapeño pairs its compute die with six stacks of HBM4 and an I/O chiplet.
chineseTitle: OpenAI 如何利用自己的法学硕士来设计 Jalapeo 芯片
chineseContent:
人工智能大大缩短了设计时间；只会变得更快

Matthew S. Smith 是 IEEE Spectrum 的特约编辑，也是 Digital Trends 的前首席评论编辑。

OpenAI 的 Jalapeo 将其计算芯片与六个 HBM4 堆栈和一个 I/O 小芯片配对。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
